system.summary: Chinese telegraph code numbers disguised by three different keys, one per correspondent's code book: a tens-digit permutation and subtraction from 9000 (共密), per-place digit substitutions plus 0901 (容密), and a reordered code with pages counted backwards over zero-free numbers (辰密).
system.notes: The forms carry the digits in kanji numerals in a grid, read in columns right to left; the stream is cut into four-digit groups. The first two groups are a clear prefix naming the code book. Three different keys: by the writeup skill's one-key rule they could be split into three targets.

prior_solution.where: None known: the texts are not in Hsueh Chun-tu's edition of Huang Xing's 1916 drafts, which has nothing between 8 and 20 June, nor online (Dudout, juin1916 page). 黃興集 and Li Yuanhong's correspondence not yet checked.

conditions.human_role: Contributed: Brice Dudout read the digits on the JACAR scans (blind re-reading), chose leads and criteria; Claude wrote the solvers, tests and log and proposed hypotheses; Codex made the first 共密 trials. The project checked the keys and reran his controls.
models: OpenAI Codex (early 共密 trials; version not supplied)

solution.what: Contributor: forms read in columns right to left, four-digit groups; first sheets of every telegram, then continuation sheets (about 590 容密 groups); all digits re-read blind by Brice Dudout except 18 of V4B's 22 sheets.
Contributor, 共密: for each of the 10,000 constants K the optimal tens permutation by exact assignment, scored by a CTC unigram/bigram model; K = 9000 and φ = 9761405283.
Contributor, 容密: 90 first-sheet groups too few; on about 590 groups, four per-place digit substitutions annealed into readable text.

Contributor, 容密: 借甸 (3949) for 借款 (2949) exactly when the hundreds gave no carry revealed an additive; exact key (tables + 0901 with carries) computed on N02, N08, N11, N12; rule 90 = 00 added from the groups beginning 90.
Contributor, 辰密: 共密 and 容密 keys failed; permuted-page + permuted tens/units model annealed on N13, N16, N26 (201 groups); exact assignment stuck in false optima.
Contributor, 辰密: the page table found follows the countdown of numbers without a zero, then imposed; 劈 for 力 and 滠 for 灰, both from groups ending 9, gave the rule units 9 = 10.

Contributor: 容密 key from four telegrams reads the other ten unrefitted; 辰密 N05 (not in the search, no prefix) reads through; N16 ends 灰 matching its date; V4B, V4D, V4E never used to find the keys read unchanged; names fit June 1916 office-holders.

Project: his verify.py rerun with python -I: 32/32 published raw texts reproduced; scores 共密 3.492, 容密 3.179, 辰密 3.773 against maxima of 200 random keys (-1.450, -1.665, -1.588) and 200 digit shuffles (-1.224, -1.455, -1.177).

Project: his search_gongmi.py recovers K = 9000 and φ exactly from scratch (3.492; shuffled nulls -1.10, -1.07, -1.09); search_rongmi.py gives K = 0900 with hundreds and tens exact, units equivalent up to the carry, thousands off on 7/8/9 (2.608 vs 3.179 for the published key; nulls -1.10, -1.19).

Project: own decoder written from the stated keys (decode.py, Unihan kTaiwanTelegraph table from targets/sunyatsen/tw.csv) applied to his re-read digits: 2472/2472 groups and 32/32 telegrams identical to his raw texts (共密 555/555, 容密 1306/1306, 辰密 239/239).

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): cipher groups ct_gongmi/rongmi/chenmi.txt; decode.py run over groups.tsv and saved per code as texts/<code>_decryption.md; Dudout's keys copied from NOTES to texts/key.md; his annotated texts and translations linked on his Wenmi pages

Reading audit, per-document pass (George Lasry's sentence test): the three decode files read telegram by telegram: chenmi reads; gongmi (N32, N33, N35) and rongmi (N19b, N21, V4D) carry garbled character clusters that break whole clauses. Per-document C confirmed for both; relabelled decoded, not read; class read in part kept; fraction_read 0.9238 -> 0.11.

outcome.method_basis: All three keys were found by key searches scored with a telegraph-code language model, without cribs or plaintext (Dudout's method pages); only the form dates served as checks.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Reading audit, 22 Oct 2026: of the three codebooks only 辰密 (chenmi) reads in the repository; 共密 and 容密 are decoded, not read. Contributor's counts (email 19 Oct 2026), chenmi 232 of 239 groups read, over the 2,100 groups measured here: 232/2,100 = 0.11. The earlier 0.9238 (1,940/2,100, all three codebooks) is withdrawn as a reading figure.

validation.notes: plaintext is Chinese (telegraph code numbers); no letter model in lang/. The contributor's verify.py random-key and digit-shuffle nulls were rerun instead (2026-10-20).

credits.note: Three numeric telegraph codes of June–July 1916 (共密, 容密, 辰密): digits re-read on the JACAR scans, keys recovered with Claude (mainly Opus 5.5), translations and historical context

texts.label: 共密, 9 telegrams, June-July 1916
texts.summary: Telegrams between Huang Xing's circle in Tokyo and the Shanghai group, intercepted in Japan: among them Huang Xing's five conditions to Li Yuanhong (restore the 1912 Provisional Constitution and the old Parliament, no amnesty, Duan's cabinet to resign, move Wang Zhanyuan, bring the party leaders to Beijing; N17). Key recovered by Brice Dudout; decrypted here with an independent decoder from his digit readings.
texts.note: Verbatim decoder output: N17, N18, N23 are near-clean classical Chinese, but N32, N33 and N35 carry strings of wrong characters (代噸 for 代表, 圄會 for 國會) so whole clauses fail, and no translation is in the folder (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026); fix: copy Brice Dudout's edited texts and translations from his Wenmi pages into texts/, check the garbled groups against groups.tsv and the JACAR scans, and repair them.

texts.label: 容密, 14 telegrams, June-July 1916
texts.summary: Telegrams on the arms bought in Japan for Zhejiang (Governor Lü Gongwang): about 10,000 rifles, mountain guns and machine guns, ammunition and payment before 30 June, loans and tobacco taxes as security; Japan will not lend to Beijing before North and South are unified; 'no legal solution without armed force'; the meeting at Tang's house; late June, Duan back to three delegates per province.
texts.note: Most telegrams (N08, N11, N14, N19a) read, but N19b, N21 and V4D have clusters of mis-decoded characters (圄會, 恢徨) and N21's second half is garbled; verbatim decoder output, no translation in the folder (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026); fix: copy Brice Dudout's edited texts and translations from his Wenmi pages into texts/, check the garbled groups against groups.tsv and the JACAR scans, and repair them.

texts.label: 辰密, 4 telegrams, June 1916
texts.summary: Telegrams to the Hunanese group's address at 277 Avenue Joffre, Shanghai, including a Hunan division under Zhao Hengti for Li Yuanhong (N16).
